card.name: Small words before counteract-type verbs
card.fires_on: Small words like "to" and "be" right before a verb of stopping, containing or reversing something, such as contain, deter, counteract, correct or discontinue. Seen after "may", "should", "can" or "little".

modes.label: Passive "be" after a modal
modes.description: "be" after may, can or should, before a verb like corrected, counteracted or discontinued.
modes.example: Hypotension and circulatory collapse may<< be>> counteracted by use of intravenous fluids

modes.label: "to" before a stopping verb
modes.description: "to" that leads into a verb of containing, deterring or reversing.
modes.example: Reform efforts undertaken by 17th-century sultans did little<< to>> deter the onset of decay.
